title: 结构化知识架构信息图
author: 知识猫图解
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,海报 / 传单,极简主义,图解 / 图表,文字 / 排版
prompt_en: Please generate a high-end Chinese knowledge architecture infographic with a vertical 9:16 composition. The overall visual language is fixed as: light cream-white grid paper background + cover-level oversized bold title + high-saturation blue-purple-magenta gradient keyword capsule bar + white-base black-bordered structural modules + colorful small capsule labels inside modules + blue arrow closed-loop connections. This is not an ordinary flowchart or a tech UI panel. Please generate a high-end infographic similar to a high-quality knowledge blogger's course cover, knowledge payment system diagram, or methodology architecture poster. The overall style must be restrained, clean, and highly orderly, but local colorful labels must be striking enough to make the image richer and more layered than an ordinary black-and-white architecture diagram. 1. Fixed Visual Style: Background: Use a light cream-white grid paper background with very fine, light gray grid lines. No gradients, dark backgrounds, heavy shadows, glassmorphism, skeuomorphism, tech HUD, or cyber UI. General Vibe: Minimalist, restrained, rational, and orderly structure. Black and white skeleton with colors used only for keyword bars, small labels, emphasis blocks, and blue arrows. 2. Top Title Area Layout: Top description sentence (small centered text extracted from content), Oversized bold Chinese main title (the largest visual element with high visual impact), and a Horizontal high-saturation gradient keyword capsule bar (blue to purple to magenta transition with 3 core keywords separated by white dots). 3. Main Module Structure Rules: 3-layer structure (3 + 3 + 4 modules). Total of 10 white-base modules with black borders and small rounded corners. Each module contains a Chinese title, English sub-title, 2-4 short sentences, and colorful small capsule labels. 4. Content Automatic Arrangement Rules: Automatically extract and organize content into Strategy/Cognition (Layer 1), Action/Execution (Layer 2), and Input/Output/Brand (Layer 3). Use colorful labels for categories, sources, methods, tools, etc. If content is insufficient, maintain the 3+3+4 structure with reasonable generalizations. 5. Module Internal Color Accents: Vibrant colors must come from labels, not background colors. At least 5 modules must include high-saturation small capsule labels from the pool of blue, purple, magenta, orange, green, and cyan. 6. Blue Arrow Loop Rules: Use medium-high saturation blue arrows to show the flow from top to bottom and returning to create a closed loop. 7. Text Hierarchy: Clear weighting from the main title (thickest/largest) to the gradient bar text, module titles, and then body text. 8. Final Acceptance Criteria: Ensure grid background, top description, oversized title, gradient keyword bar, 3+3+4 module structure, colorful labels, and blue closed-loop arrows are all present and satisfy the style requirements. 9. Prohibitions: No gradient/dark backgrounds, no large color cards, no glassmorphism, no complex illustrations, no PPT or mind map styles, and no gray arrows. 10. User Variables: Top Title (Fill in main title here) and Content (Fill in natural language content here to be automatically processed).\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a glossy anime-style fantasy payment card design for Komari Hanasaki, themed around pink cosmos flowers and a dreamy sunset garden.

Canvas: Horizontal rounded-rectangle credit card, 16:10 ratio, shown straight-on against a plain white background with a soft drop shadow. The card has rounded corners, a thin pale border, and a polished plastic finish.

Visual style: Soft romantic anime illustration, pastel pink, lavender, peach, and warm gold palette, luminous sunset sky, delicate sparkles, floating petals, shallow depth of field, elegant premium card aesthetic.

Main illustration: A young anime girl with short dark brown bobbed hair and a small ahoge sits among blooming cosmos flowers. She wears a pale white-pink sleeveless dress with subtle lace and a pink waist ribbon. Her face is covered by a centered opaque square privacy block in muted brown-pink, approximately one quarter of the card height and width, placed over the upper-right-center of the portrait.

Background: A field of pink cosmos flowers fills the entire card, with large blossoms on both left and right edges, smaller flowers behind the character, glowing particles, soft clouds, and drifting petals in the sky.

Card elements: Include exactly 7 main card UI/text elements: 1 gold EMV chip on the left, 1 white contactless symbol on the upper right, 1 large card title, 1 embossed card number line, 1 cardholder label/name block, 1 expiry block, and 1 payment brand logo.

Text content: Top left large white cursive script reads Komari with a small flower mark near the final letter. Beneath it, spaced uppercase serif text reads “COSMOS CARD”. Across the middle, embossed metallic-gold digits are divided into exactly 4 groups: “1234”, “5678”, “9012”, “3456”. Bottom left label reads “CARDHOLDER”, with embossed name “KOMARI HANASAKI” below it. Near the lower center, small text reads “GOOD THRU”, above/near “MONTH/YEAR”, with expiry “00/00”. Bottom right white logo reads LUMINA PAY, with “LUMINA” large, “PAY” below, and a curved smile underline.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and aligned like a premium credit card. Use metallic embossing on the card number and cardholder name. Do not add extra numbers, logos, watermarks, or additional card fields.\

prompt_en: Beautiful young woman with the exact facial identity, facial structure, skin tone, proportions, and visual likeness of the reference subject. She stands in a relaxed editorial pose with one knee slightly bent and her shoulders angled naturally toward camera, wearing a fitted ivory ribbed crop top, tailored retro-inspired yellow athletic shorts with crimson side piping, and a translucent lightweight rain jacket. Her hair is styled in a sleek high ponytail with delicate flyaway strands illuminated by studio lighting. She carries a premium structured fast-food campaign tote finished in glossy red with metallic gold arch detailing. Dominating the scene is an enormous oversized Happy Meal-inspired box transformed into a monumental sculptural installation. Rather than sitting directly behind her, the giant box is positioned diagonally across the background, creating dramatic depth and perspective. Hundreds of golden fries burst upward and outward from the opening in a swirling arc, appearing to float through the air like a cinematic golden tornado. The fries vary in distance from camera, enhancing dimensionality and visual energy. Dynamic atmospheric effects fill the set: sparkling ice fragments, mist-like condensation, and suspended water droplets frozen in motion. Tiny droplets bead naturally on the transparent jacket surface, producing realistic light refractions and subtle spectral highlights. Shot from a slightly lower camera angle to create a heroic advertising perspective. Captured on a Phase One IQ4 150MP with an 80mm lens at f/2.0, generating exceptional detail on the subject while allowing background elements to transition into luxurious depth separation. Lighting setup: large overhead softbox for elegant skin rendering, directional key light from camera left for shape and definition, and a powerful rim light creating a luminous contour around the figure and transparent jacket. Additional floor reflections bounce warm highlights into the scene. Environment: pristine seamless white studio cyclorama with a highly polished reflective resin floor, producing long cinematic reflections of both the model and the giant product installation. Color treatment: contemporary luxury advertising grade with vibrant reds, rich golden yellows, clean whites, subtle contrast, warm highlights, and crisp commercial clarity. Hyperrealistic 8K CGI, Unreal Engine 5 quality, advanced global illumination, realistic skin subsurface scattering, premium international fast-food campaign aesthetic, luxury brand photography, ultra-detailed textures, photoreal masterpiece.\

Canvas: Wide horizontal canvas, approximately 16:9, pure white background with generous empty margins. Center the icon group horizontally and vertically with lots of whitespace.

2. Blue camera with yellow shutter button and circular lens on a pale blue circle.
3. Blue-and-white milk carton with a yellow splash graphic on a pale blue circle.

7. Red gift box with yellow ribbon and bow on a pale pink circle.

author: Olivio Sarikas
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,电影感 / 电影剧照,肖像 / 自拍,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en:
Create a cinematic production board / visual planning sheet that presents a complete concept for a short film or commercial. The layout should be clean, grid-based, and divided into clearly labeled sections.    

Include:  Shared creative direction (top bar): overall constraints such as number of shots, unified color palette, and general environmental context.      

Character + styling reference section:  A model shown from multiple angles (front, back, side, close-ups, relaxed pose), accompanied by wardrobe and accessory references. Emphasize consistency of identity while allowing minor variations for specific scenes.      

Environment and set design section:  A scenic outdoor location with dramatic natural features, plus a top-down diagram illustrating movement through the space. Include camera positions and labeled shot types mapped along a route.      

Storyboard section: A sequence of numbered frames (about 8 shots) showing progression of the scene. Each frame includes:  Camera type / lens feel  Shot size (wide, medium, close-up, macro)  Movement (static, tracking, handheld, etc.)  Brief description of action and emotional progression      Lighting / mood / style notes:  Visual examples paired with short descriptions of lighting conditions, atmosphere, and texture. Include transitions across time of day and variations in light quality.    Mood and keywords block: A concise list of emotional tones and thematic descriptors guiding the piece.      

Audio / tone section:  Indications of ambient sound, music style, and overall sonic atmosphere.      

Cinematography notes:  General visual philosophy including lens characteristics, movement style, and post-processing feel.     
 
The entire board should feel cohesive, cinematic, and professionally designed—like a director’s pre-production guide that communicates tone, pacing, and visual storytelling at a glance.\

title: 苏州园林旗袍肖像
author: ToroJushiAi
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,网红 / 模特,风景 / 自然
prompt_en:
Authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. A three-quarter length portrait of a young woman mid-stride on a narrow wooden zigzag bridge (九曲桥) crossing a classical Suzhou garden lotus pond. She is in a gentle walking pause — one foot slightly ahead, gaze turned downward toward the water. Large dark-green lotus leaves spread below, rain-beaded at their edges; the water between shows a pale sky reflection. An age-darkened low wooden balustrade runs at her right.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes cast downward with a small thoughtful expression — neither smiling nor unsmiling, simply present and absorbed. Straight refined nose. Fair skin in the cool morning garden light. Elegant upswept chignon with two thin crossed hairpins at the crown, a small white flower tucked near the ear. Light elegant makeup — near-bare coverage, lips in a barely-tinted neutral. Skin subsurface scattering visible even in the cooler morning light, a faint internal warmth at the cheeks, specular micro-highlights subdued and soft, fine foundation powder grain perceptible.
She wears a sleeveless modern-improved qipao in pale sage-green — a muted, slightly dusty bamboo tone, not saturated — mandarin collar with pale grey-green frog closures, the skirt cut with a slightly more generous soft drape falling to mid-calf. Both hands are relaxed at her sides, the right near the balustrade. The wooden bridge planks are dark with age and moisture; the lotus pond fills the lower background, the round leaves layered in lush summer abundance. The far bank shows grey garden wall stone and the suggestion of weeping willow. Two or three arrow hairs at her temple have been gently displaced by the water-garden air, their small curves irregular and soft.
Morning light is directional from the left — a cool-warm transition of early day, casting long gentle shadows across the bridge planks and catching the outer edges of lotus leaves below. Water surface reflections add a secondary scattered fill — pale and diffused — softening the shadow areas beneath the bridge rail and giving the scene a particularly gentle luminosity. The overall mood is peaceful and unhurried, the garden in a private morning moment. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in the shadow areas of the lotus pond and darker bridge wood tones, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 2:3. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical anime/fantasy collectible poster for The Champion, styled like a nostalgic monster-partner adventure magazine cover, blending realistic lighting with high-detail creature design.

Canvas: Tall portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, warm beige and gold color grading, dusty sunlit atmosphere, dramatic backlight, floating digital pixel fragments, subtle paper-grain texture, premium key visual composition.

Main subject: A young woman hero stands in the center foreground, running forward and reaching one hand toward the viewer. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain medium-brown rectangular censor block. She has dark brown hair in a loose low bun, soft flyaway strands, a delicate necklace, a cream floral summer dress, and a loose white cardigan. In her outstretched hand she holds a glowing round digital device with a bright blue circular core and metallic gold casing.

Creature count: Include exactly 5 monster companions. 1) A huge crystalline white-and-gold dragon fills the upper background, arcing behind the hero, with jagged crystal armor, long golden horns, open roaring mouth, sharp teeth, and one glowing electric-blue eye. 2) A tiny orange winged mascot sits near the hero’s raised hand, cute face, blue eyes, small bat-like wings, and cheerful expression. 3) A blue-gray horned wolf/reptile creature crouches on the lower left behind the hero, spiky fur scales, one striped horn, open snarling mouth, collar, and gem pendant. 4) An orange dinosaur-like creature occupies the bottom left foreground, big green eye, open happy roaring mouth, rounded snout, collar, and blue gem pendant. 5) A white cat-rabbit creature on the lower right, blue eyes, purple-tipped ear tufts, fluffy body, collar, gem pendant, and alert pose.

Layout and typography: Place large bold black sans-serif title text in the upper left reading The Champion. Above it, add small text reading “DIGIMON CHAMPION EDITION” with tiny circular icons. Under the title, add Japanese subtitle text: 「選ばれし絆、未来へ。」 and a smaller Japanese line beneath it. Add left-side editorial markings: “01”, “DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION”, a vertical barcode, and a small globe icon. Add right-side markings: a circular champion emblem, “DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION”, “No.2025”, vertical Japanese text, and thin measurement-line graphics. Add bottom-left collectible card panel with “LEGEND” and Japanese text 「伝説のチャンピオン」. Add bottom-right black label panel with “CHAMPION”, “The Chosen One”, a signature scribble, and barcode-like decoration.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed anime-realism, cinematic fantasy poster, high-end game promotional art, glossy creature eyes, crystalline scales, warm dust particles, volumetric sunlight, shallow depth of field, dynamic diagonal composition, heroic nostalgic adventure mood.

Constraints: Keep the composition crowded but readable, use exactly the 5 listed creatures, preserve the obscured face block, avoid extra characters, avoid logos or watermarks beyond the designed fictional poster text.\
